notes: This is a European 220-240 V 50 Hz model, not a US 115 V unit. The parts list is for GDN40AU-K3EBA1A (product code CK051024400).

gaps: The PDF has no printed date (its file metadata says April 2016).
The supply voltage is a whole-unit figure, so it is not put on any part.
The electric box lists two capacitors, CBB65 (33000081) and CBB61S (3301074702), without saying which serves which motor.
No uF value is put on either capacitor part number.
The humidity sensor has no separate part number in the list; its cover plate is listed.
method: Source is Gree Electric Appliances' own service manual for GDN40AU-K3EBA1A and GDN40AW-K3EBA1A (R410A), served as a PDF from the download site of Gree Magyarorszag, which describes itself as Gree's Hungarian representative.

Read as text and checked against rendered images of the spec sheet (PDF p.4), the GDN40AU-K3EBA1A wiring diagram (PDF p.7) and the main-board silk-screen diagram (PDF p.9) on 2026-11-12; the manual has one main-board diagram, and both models list the same main board, 30131489.
The parts list is on PDF pp.24-25.
The spec sheet gives 50 pints/day rated, 570 W / 2.65 A whole-unit input and R410A 0.31 kg.
The spec sheet names the compressor maker as Zhuhai Landa Compressor Co., Ltd.
The wiring diagram draws C1 at the fan motor and C2 at the compressor, and the spec sheet gives the fan motor capacitor as 2 uF.

comps.spec: Rotary compressor QXA-A071L130C made by Zhuhai Landa Compressor Co., Ltd.; 630 W input, RLA 2.9 A, LRA 15 A, oil RB68EP; Gree part 'compressor and fittings' 00106098; R410A 0.31 kg
CBB65 capacitor, Gree part 33000081, in the electric box
CBB61S capacitor, Gree part 3301074702, in the electric box
Fan motor, 20 W output, RLA 0.35 A, 1260/1070/900 rpm (high/med/low), Gree part 15016072; centrifugal fan 192 x 66 mm, part 10316074
Liquid level switch, Gree part 45016506 (sub-assembly 45016014), with float meter sub-assembly 2611652605 in the water tank assembly

Ambient humidity sensor; appendix 3 gives its resistance-vs-humidity table, and error code L1 means a shorted or broken sensor. The parts list carries a temperature and humidity sensor cover plate, Gree part 20126511
Temperature sensor, 20 kOhm thermistor ('20KT', 20 kOhm at 25 C per appendix 2), Gree part 390000595
Stepping motor, Gree part 1521200601, listed next to the guide louver and a crank
Main board, Gree part 30131489, in the electric box; separate display board 300001000059
Compressor drive relay on the main board (silk-screen diagram item 9); the silk screen marks positions K1 to K5
Main-board fuse FU1, silk screen marked T3.15AH 250V (spec sheet fuse current 3.15 A)
High-frequency transformer on the main board (silk-screen diagram item 10)
Varistor (called 'piezoresistor' in the manual, position RV1) on the main board

sources.title: Gree service manual, dehumidifier models GDN40AU-K3EBA1A and GDN40AW-K3EBA1A (R410A), Gree Electric Appliances Inc. of Zhuhai, PDF on the Gree Magyarorszag download site
